title: Cloud Security: collection grace
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for collection grace.

## Basis

Collection grace term in calendar days: Calendar days after invoice maturity before collection suspension; integer.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Collection grace term in calendar days |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | 15 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | 15 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | 15 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | 15 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | 15 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | 15 |

## Tier comparison

The listed collection grace bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
